frames.title: Open the assurance workspace
frames.caption: Start with npm start, then open http://127.0.0.1:4234
frames.narration: Open Safeguard by running npm start and visiting the local address. This recorded walkthrough uses sample data and actual signed transactions on a local network. Each role sees a focused workspace.

frames.title: Required evidence is missing
frames.caption: Three scenarios for each of two configurations
frames.narration: The candidate requires evidence for driver attention, mode confusion and operating boundaries in two configurations. Missing results remain visible. No release authority exists simply because a candidate has been registered.

frames.title: A decision is blocked
frames.caption: An independent reviewer cannot approve incomplete coverage
frames.narration: The safety reviewer attempts a limited release decision before the required evidence is complete. The contract rejects the request. The interface explains which evidence must be inspected instead of creating an unsupported approval.

frames.title: The engineer submits validation results
frames.caption: 39 successful responses out of 40 trials in each scenario
frames.narration: The engineer submits six laboratory records. Each records thirty nine successful responses out of forty trials. Current evidence now satisfies the illustrative laboratory rules, making the candidate eligible for independent assessment.

frames.title: An independent reviewer makes the judgment
frames.caption: A rationale and validity period are required
frames.narration: Only the reviewer workspace exposes release decisions. The reviewer documents the evidence assessed, remaining uncertainty and decision conditions. The contract requires a separate reviewing identity, a rationale fingerprint and an expiry date.

frames.title: Limited deployment is authorised
frames.caption: The decision applies to the current evidence snapshot
frames.narration: The recorded decision authorises limited deployment for the current build and evidence revision. Field effectiveness remains a separate question. The workflow does not treat a laboratory decision as permission for unrestricted expansion.

frames.title: The analyst supplies a field comparison
frames.caption: Baseline 8 / 4,000 miles; post-update 12 / 4,000 miles
frames.narration: The field analyst submits a comparison with eight baseline events over four thousand engaged miles and twelve post update events over the same exposure. Completeness, comparability and safeguard activation are explicitly recorded.

frames.title: The event rate deteriorates
frames.caption: 2.0 becomes 3.0 events per 1,000 engaged miles
frames.narration: The event rate increases from two to three per one thousand engaged miles. This adverse result fails the configured field check. Review reopens and current release authority is invalidated.

frames.title: The concern has an owner and deadline
frames.caption: An investigation is assigned to the engineer, due in seven days
frames.narration: The contract creates an investigation action assigned to the candidate's engineer, with a deadline seven days later. The concern cannot disappear merely because another team completes a task or because a dashboard is refreshed.

frames.title: Overdue follow-up is escalated
frames.caption: The safety lead sees ownership and overdue status
frames.narration: The prototype clock is advanced eight days to exercise the deadline. A separate escalation transaction records the overdue action for the safety lead. This is a local test control, and no vehicle command or email is sent.

frames.title: Improved evidence leaves the action open
frames.caption: Eligible field results do not automatically resolve a concern
frames.narration: Follow up evidence now satisfies the field rules, but the investigation remains open and there is still no current deployment authority. Better measurements do not automatically establish that the earlier concern has been resolved.

frames.title: Resolution receives independent scrutiny
frames.caption: Resolution evidence and a dedicated closure rationale are recorded
frames.narration: The independent reviewer inspects the investigation and follow up evidence. A resolution summary and a separate closure rationale are recorded. Candidate data contributors and the concern's reporter cannot close the action themselves.

frames.title: Closure is separate from release
frames.caption: Zero open actions still does not create a new approval
frames.narration: The action is now closed, but release authority remains unavailable. Closing an investigation records a judgment about that concern. A separate release decision is required for the revised evidence snapshot.

frames.title: A separate expansion decision is recorded
frames.caption: Current evidence, no open actions and an independent judgment
frames.narration: The reviewer makes a separate expansion decision after inspecting the complete current evidence. The contract records a new snapshot and validity period. This authorises the workflow stage without claiming to certify vehicle safety.

frames.title: A new build makes earlier evidence stale
frames.caption: The earlier approval cannot silently apply to changed software
frames.narration: The engineer revises the software build. Earlier laboratory and field evidence is now stale, and the previous authority no longer applies. The new build must obtain fresh evidence and renewed independent assessment.

frames.title: Earlier judgments remain inspectable
frames.caption: History preserves the original decision basis
frames.narration: The original limited and expansion decisions remain visible with their reviewing address, evidence revision, validity window and snapshot fingerprints. Reopening review preserves accountability for what was decided before the change.

frames.title: The auditor can reconstruct the record
frames.caption: Read-only history and exportable evidence fingerprints
frames.narration: The auditor has a read only view of evidence, decisions, actions and confirmed events. The review export retains canonical evidence preimages and transaction details. The result is an inspectable assurance trail supporting accountable decisions.
